pilat-ridge-and-monastery-roads.slogan: A 131 km loop out of Yzeron ridge roads
pilat-ridge-and-monastery-roads.story: Green hills close to the city, enough corners to matter. A 131 km loop that starts and ends near Courzieu, about 2 h 32 of riding. On the way it passes Sainte-Croix-en-Jarez and Pilat. Col de la République is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-p.title: San Bernardino · Splügen Long Alpine Day · part 2
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-p.slogan: Mesocco food to Chur fuel · one way

waypoints.name: Mesocco food reset
waypoints.advice: Mesocco is where the day begins. Next is Splügenpass hairpins, climbing 1324 m.

waypoints.name: Splügenpass hairpins
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2114 m here. The road climbs 1324 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Thusis return, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Thusis return gate
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 57 km left and no pump marked after this. You lose 1394 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Back to Chur fuel.

waypoints.name: Back to Chur fuel
waypoints.advice: Back to Chur fuel closes the day.

sections.advice: Mesocco food reset → Splügenpass hairpins climbs about 1324 m in 18 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Splügenpass hairpins → Thusis return gate drops about 1394 m over 29 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Thusis return gate → Back to Chur fuel is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2114 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 56 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-p.story: Out of Mesocco, one way: 172 km, roughly 3 h 17 in the saddle. Splügenpass hairpins is the high point. It tops out at 2,114 m. Splugen Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.
